QUOTE: "`schema`, index newer than server | Server predates index | Restart the MCP client. A rebuild cannot clear it, since it re-stamps the same newer version." and "`code` | Process loaded old logic | Restart the MCP client. A rebuild cannot fix it." and "`data` | Sources changed since build | `index(action='refresh')`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that data is cleared by a refresh/rebuild while code needs a client restart that a rebuild cannot fix, which is the substance of the different-remedy-per-axis point.
